title: Integral Hamiltonian Floer theory: Foundations
summary: Continuing our previous work on the integral Arnold conjecture, we establish the foundation of Hamiltonian Floer theory over integer coefficients on any compact symplectic manifold. This package produces a well-defined chain homotopy class of Floer complexes, chain-level continuation maps, the Piunikhin--Salamon--Schwarz (PSS) isomorphism, and an associative pair-of-pants product.
